items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: He -- and up to that time he was the only fellow who ever fired me, see.

ctx.x: at that point Jelly Roll had already accomplished quite a bit. He'd made a lot of records. For him to -- you would -- one would think he was too big to take a job like that at that stage.

Well, I often wondered about that, but I figured he -- Jelly Roll was a sort of an up and down guy, you know, like he would be in the chips now and six months from then he would be down. Because -- which I suppose was -- you could attribute to his personality, his inability to get along too good with people, as they say. Jelly Roll was a battler, you know, an old school fighter. He used to tell stories, you know. I hadn't paid too much attention to them. But at that time Jelly Roll was sort of gruff, you know, a…
